question: Where is the Rumi Darwaza located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow.**__

__
 
• **Rumi Darwaza is located in Lucknow.​**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rumi Darwaza is also known as the Turkish gate was built by Nawab-Asaf-Ud-Daula,
 
• It was built in the year 1784.
 
• The sixy feet massive gate is situated between Bara imambara and Chota Imambara.
 
• It is an example of Awadhi architecture.
 
• Awadhi school of architecture is an attempt to preserve the Mughal school of architecture
